Paying off all debt first can mean skipping free money.

Credit cards that charged interest averaged 22.15% APR in Q2 2026 (Federal Reserve).
New federal undergrad student loans for 2026-27 are fixed at 6.52%.
The most common 401(k) match in Vanguard-run plans: 50 cents per $1, up to 6% of pay.
Example: $50,000 salary, 6% = $3,000, employer adds $1,500. The same $3,000 on a 22.15% card would avoid about $665 to $740 a year in interest.

Sources: Federal Reserve G.19 (Aug 2026), Federal Student Aid (June 2026), Vanguard How America Saves 2026.
News and education, not financial advice.
